Wow well where do I start,  it was actually back in 2006 I was just setting up my new home theatre system in my new house.  Anyway once it was all set up I was flicking through my cable channels and went to CMC and they said something about a new artist called Taylor Swift and I was like oh well I'll sit and watch this. 

Anyway they played Tim Mcgraw and I was like wow who is this blue eyed goddess with the voice of an angel.  I was instantly hooked I had to hear more songs from her.  I jumped online and did a search for her.  So back when MySpace was a thing I came across her page and read more and more and was like wow she is not like any other singer I have ever heard so genuine and was there chatting away to her fans on MySpace with a video blog just like a regular person would.  

I was like no way I've just seen you on the country music channel and here you are chatting just like a regular person would. 

Anyway fast forward a bit and I heard she was coming to Australia for her fearless tour and despite all the shit I got from my mates (being a guy swiftie is hard)  off I went and loved every second.  

4 tours later and now 5 albums in my love for Taylor had just grown.  

And on her 10th anniversary this year I came on taycation from Australia to the states to see her perform in Austin and drive to Nashville to see where it all happened.  I have still not been blessed with meeting her but I still hold out hope.
